definition_audit.definition: Exists A:X x I -> Real and B:I x Y -> Real with every entry F(x,y)=sum_i A(x,i)B(i,y), I finite, X/Y arbitrary; empty I yields zero F. No canonical, unique or executable factors selected.

A_k(t)=sum_(r=0..k) (sum_(m=0..r) choose(k+r-m,k)/m!)t^r; with t=p+1, P_k(p)=exp(-1)(1-t)^(k+1)A_k(t)+t^(k+1)A_k(1-t). Natural coefficients/factorials cast into Real. Not an arbitrary promised polynomial oracle.

Least nonnegative integer at least a real argument, hence zero for nonpositive arguments. Existence/leastness from Archimedean/well-order facts and exact strict-inequality characterization are required dependency facts; no arbitrary fallback semantics or runtime promise.
H_T(x,y)=1[M*u(x)+v(y)<T] in Real; complement is 1-H_T. Exact strict natural cut, no softened comparison.
exp(p) if p<-1; fixed P_k(p) for -1<=p<=0; exp(-p) for p>0. Right branch at zero is an equal-value reformulation using P_k(0)=1, not a new target.

W_k=((Two x Unit)+((Two+Two) x Fin(2k+2)))+(Two x Unit); F(x,y)=f_k(a+h*(M*u(x)+v(y))). row=a+h*M*u; col=h*v; T_left=ceil_N((-1-a)/h), T_right=ceil_N((0-a)/h). Tags are witness composition, not registers or minimal ranks.
Dimension of column span/image of the matrix map; finite Y is assumed for the stated natural-number rank bounds, not finite X. No exact-rank, numerical-rank or optimality definition.
